comparison.objective: Turn an upright taped carton upside down, cut its bottom tape, open all bottom flaps, collapse the intact carton, and leave it flat.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual turnover of a free carton, guarded blade tracking, articulated flap opening, and controlled wall-tube collapse.
comparison.success_condition: After a measured 0.5 s inverted hold, all 158 tape cells must be cut; all four bottom flaps must physically reach at least 150°; final full credit requires all eight flaps within 15° of their wall planes, all board vertices in a 24 mm slab with specified heights, speed below 10 mm/s, cutter parked, hands clear, and a 1 s hold. Crease separation, premature forced flap opening, drops, invalid angle history, or cutting before turnover invalidate. No task.json or completed full demonstration is present.
comparison.reason: Carton turnover, cutting, hinge articulation, and flattening test different force-control and manipulation capabilities from pin insertion, load-bearing ball-lock engagement, suspended-part seating, and unloaded extraction.
